assumptions: Columns are scheme positions: two chains share a column exactly when their numbering gives them the same position.
Properties are of the numbered V domain, not the whole record, so constant regions do not enter the comparison.
CDR charge sums the side-chain charges of the CDR residues at the pH (Bjellqvist pKs, as ProtParam), with no termini.
limits: Heavy and light chains cannot share an alignment; kappa and lambda can, as both number on the light scale.
A record with no domain of the chosen class is refused by name, as is a domain the scheme leaves un-numbered.
Sequence-derived: no structure, so no surface patches or paratope.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the numbered alignment and per-chain properties, which the outputs carry; the Antibody panel's Compare section shows them as a table and writes no reading over them.
bio.jane/contract.question: How do these antibodies' heavy (or light) variable domains differ position by position, and how do their lengths, pI, charge, hydropathy, extinction and CDR charge compare?

description: Several antibodies side by side: each record numbered by ANARCI, its heavy or its light variable domains aligned column by column by their numbering (a column is one scheme position, so nothing is re-aligned and an insertion is its own column), the CDR of every column under the chosen definition, how many columns agree, and the same properties read off each V domain: length, mass, isoelectric point, net charge, GRAVY, ε280 and the net charge of its CDRs. The alignment is abnumber's `Chain.align`, graded against it over every chain of ANARCI's PDB benchmark; the properties against Biopython ProtParam.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

antibodies.description: the antibody chains to compare: wire several upstream records here, or list library documents or protein sequences.

chain.description: which variable domains to align: heavy, or light (kappa and lambda together). Values: heavy (Heavy), light (Light (kappa and lambda)).

definition.description: the CDR definition, numbered in its own scheme (North in Chothia's). Values: imgt (IMGT), kabat (Kabat), chothia (Chothia), north (North).

pH.description: the pH the net charge and the CDR charge are reported at.

name: compare_antibodies

alignment.description: the alignment as abnumber prints it: rows, identity lines, and the CDRs marked ^ (Vernier °, under Kabat)

chains.description: per chain: name, record, chain type, and its V domain's length, molecularWeight (Da), isoelectricPoint, chargeAtPH, gravy, extinction (reduced and cystines) and cdrCharge

identical.description: columns where every chain holds the same residue

mutations.description: columns holding more than one residue (a gap counts as one)

positions.description: the scheme position of each column (`82A`)

refused.description: records that gave no chain of the class, each with its reason

regions.description: the region of each column under the definition: FR1, CDR1 … FR4

rows.description: one gapped row per aligned chain, `{ name, aligned }`, the shape the alignment tools read
